outcome: Craniofacial asymmetry parameters (ear-eye distance, ear-nose distance, eye-mouth distance, ear-mouth distance, half-head circumference, half-head top)

Cheng-Tang rating score (range of rotation, range of lateral flexion, status of contracted muscle, hardness of mass, extent of head tilting, status of daily activities, face size, type of head shape, cranial changes, subjective head tilting)
cohort: The study included children diagnosed with congenital muscular torticollis (CMT) who received physiotherapy between 2008 and 2018.
finding: Children with congenital muscular torticollis who experienced manual myotomy during physiotherapy generally had a good outcome, demonstrated by a significantly higher total Cheng-Tang rating score compared to those without manual myotomy, and age at initial physiotherapy session was identified as a risk factor for manual myotomy.
